---CBC Business Entity
SELECT TOP 50 * FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults WHERE ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBC_CRM%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults WHERE ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBC_CRM%' ---200,770
---CBS Business Entity
SELECT TOP 50 * FROM SYN.CBSBusinessEntityMatchResults

SELECT TOP 50 SUBSTRING(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR, 9, LEN(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR)-8) AS ACCOUNTID FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults WHERE ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBC_CRM%'
SELECT COUNT(SUBSTRING(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR, 9, LEN(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR)-8)) FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults WHERE ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBC_CRM%' - 200,770

SELECT DISTINCT(LEN(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR)) FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults WHERE ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBC_CRM%'
SELECT (LEN(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR)), count(*) FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults WHERE ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBC_CRM%' GROUP BY (LEN(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR))
SELECT TOP 10 * FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults WHERE ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBC_CRM%' AND LEN(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR) = 16
---14 - CBC_CRM_500363
---15 - CBC_CRM_2838990
---16 - CBC_CRM_10345880

---ACCOUNTID only; CRM, CBC01
WITH CBCTEST AS (
    SELECT SUBSTRING(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR, 9, LEN(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR)-8) AS ACCOUNTID 
    FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults 
    WHERE ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBC_CRM%')
---SELECT TOP 10 * FROM CBCTEST WHERE ACCOUNTID IN ('500363', '2838990', '10345880')
SELECT B.ACCOUNTID, B.ORGKEY, B.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE, D.FORACID, D.SCHM_TYPE, D.SOL_ID, D.ACCT_OPN_DATE FROM CBCTEST A 
    JOIN D360.STG_CRM_ACCOUNTS B ON A.ACCOUNTID = B.ACCOUNTID
    JOIN D360.STG_DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP C ON B.CORE_CUST_ID = C.CUST_ID
    JOIN D360.STG_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER D ON C.ACID = D.ACID
    ORDER BY ORGKEY


---Test Required Fields; CRM, CBC01; Retail Customer
WITH CBCTEST AS (
    SELECT SUBSTRING(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR, 9, LEN(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR)-8) AS ACCOUNTID, Name_Cust_Local_Name AS NAME, ADDRESS1, ADDRESS2, CITY, [STATE], 
        ATM_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT, MBK_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT, RIB_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT, [GROUP], BASE_SCORE
    FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults 
    WHERE ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBC_CRM%')
---SELECT TOP 10 * FROM CBCTEST WHERE ACCOUNTID IN ('500363', '2838990', '10345880')
SELECT B.ORGKEY AS CIFID, [GROUP], BASE_SCORE, A.NAME, 'CUSTOMER' AS [CUSTOMER TYPE], B.CUST_DOB, B.MAIDENNAMEOFMOTHER, B.GENERALTAXID, A.ADDRESS1, A.ADDRESS2, A.CITY, A.[STATE], 
        B.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE, D.FORACID, D.SCHM_TYPE, D.SOL_ID, D.ACCT_OPN_DATE,
        A.ATM_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT, A.MBK_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT, A.RIB_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT FROM CBCTEST A 
    JOIN D360.STG_CRM_ACCOUNTS B ON A.ACCOUNTID = B.ACCOUNTID
    JOIN D360.STG_DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP C ON B.CORE_CUST_ID = C.CUST_ID
    JOIN D360.STG_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER D ON C.ACID = D.ACID
    ---JOIN D360.STG_CRM_ADDRESS E ON A.ACCOUNTID = E.ACCOUNTID
    WHERE B.ORGKEY LIKE 'R%' OR B.ORGKEY LIKE 'P%'
    ORDER BY A.[GROUP]


---Test Look Up CITY and STATE value descriptions
WITH CBCTEST AS (
    SELECT SUBSTRING(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR, 9, LEN(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR)-8) AS ACCOUNTID, Name_Cust_Local_Name AS NAME, ADDRESS1, ADDRESS2, B.DESCRIPTION, [STATE], 
        ATM_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT, MBK_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT, RIB_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT, [GROUP], BASE_SCORE
    FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults JOIN D360.STG_CRM_CATEGORIES B ON A.CITY = B.VALUE 
    WHERE (B.CATEGORYTYPE = 'CITY' AND B.BANK_ID = 'CBC01') AND ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBC_CRM%')


---Look up CITY value descriptions
WITH CITY AS (
    SELECT SUBSTRING(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR, 9, LEN(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR)-8) AS ACCOUNTID, CITY, DESCRIPTION
    FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults A LEFT JOIN D360.STG_CRM_CATEGORIES B ON A.CITY = B.VALUE 
    WHERE (B.CATEGORYTYPE = 'CITY' AND BANK_ID = 'CBC01') AND ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBC_CRM%'),
---SELECT TOP 10 * FROM CITY
---Look up STATE (Province) value descriptions
[STATE] AS (
    SELECT SUBSTRING(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR, 9, LEN(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR)-8) AS ACCOUNTID, [STATE], DESCRIPTION
    FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults A LEFT JOIN D360.STG_CRM_CATEGORIES B ON A.[STATE] = B.VALUE
    WHERE (B.CATEGORYTYPE = 'STATE' AND BANK_ID = 'CBC01') AND ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBC_CRM%'),
---SELECT TOP 10 * FROM [STATE]
---Test Look Up CITY and STATE value descriptions
CBCTEST AS (
    SELECT SUBSTRING(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR, 9, LEN(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR)-8) AS ACCOUNTID, Name_Cust_Local_Name AS NAME, ADDRESS1, ADDRESS2, 
        ATM_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT, MBK_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT, RIB_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT, [GROUP], BASE_SCORE
    FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults
    WHERE ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBC_CRM%')
SELECT TOP 100 A.*, B.DESCRIPTION AS CITY, C.DESCRIPTION AS [STATE] FROM CBCTEST A 
    LEFT JOIN CITY B ON A.ACCOUNTID = B.ACCOUNTID LEFT JOIN [STATE] C ON A.ACCOUNTID = C.ACCOUNTID



SELECT TOP 10 GENERALTAXID FROM D360.STG_CRM_ACCOUNTS WHERE ORGKEY LIKE 'P%' AND GENERALTAXID IS NOT NULL OR ORGKEY LIKE 'C%'
SELECT TOP 10 TAXID, 'CUSTOMER' AS [CUSTOMER TYPE] FROM D360.STG_CRM_CORPORATE

---Test for ORGKEY and Address Details
SELECT TOP 10 B.ORGKEY, E.ADDRESS_LINE1, E.ADDRESS_LINE2, E.CITY, E.[STATE] FROM D360.STG_CRM_ACCOUNTS B JOIN D360.STG_CRM_ADDRESS E ON B.ACCOUNTID = E.ACCOUNTID
---Need to Look Up CITY and STATE code descriptions in CRM_CATEGORIES table








































































---Look up CITY value descriptions
WITH CITY AS (
    SELECT SUBSTRING(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR, 9, LEN(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR)-8) AS ACCOUNTID, CITY, DESCRIPTION
    FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults A LEFT JOIN D360.STG_CRM_CATEGORIES B ON A.CITY = B.VALUE 
    WHERE (B.CATEGORYTYPE = 'CITY' AND BANK_ID = 'CBC01') AND ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBC_CRM%'),
---Look up STATE (Province) value descriptions
[STATE] AS (
    SELECT SUBSTRING(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR, 9, LEN(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR)-8) AS ACCOUNTID, [STATE], DESCRIPTION
    FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults A LEFT JOIN D360.STG_CRM_CATEGORIES B ON A.[STATE] = B.VALUE
    WHERE (B.CATEGORYTYPE = 'STATE' AND BANK_ID = 'CBC01') AND ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBC_CRM%'),
---JOIN CITY and STATE with SKP Global Matching Result
CBCTEST AS (
    SELECT SUBSTRING(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR, 9, LEN(ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR)-8) AS ACCOUNTID, Name_Cust_Local_Name AS NAME, ADDRESS1, ADDRESS2, 
        ATM_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT, MBK_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT, RIB_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT, [GROUP], BASE_SCORE
    FROM SYN.CBCBusinessEntityMatchResults
    WHERE ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR LIKE 'CBC_CRM%')
---SELECT TOP 100 A.*, B.DESCRIPTION AS CITY, C.DESCRIPTION AS [STATE] FROM CBCTEST A 
    ---LEFT JOIN CITY B ON A.ACCOUNTID = B.ACCOUNTID LEFT JOIN [STATE] C ON A.ACCOUNTID = C.ACCOUNTID
SELECT B.ORGKEY AS CIFID, [GROUP], BASE_SCORE, A.NAME, 'CUSTOMER' AS [CUSTOMER TYPE], B.CUST_DOB, B.MAIDENNAMEOFMOTHER, B.GENERALTAXID, A.ADDRESS1, A.ADDRESS2, X.DESCRIPTION AS CITY, Y.DESCRIPTION AS [STATE], 
        B.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE, D.FORACID, D.SCHM_TYPE, D.SOL_ID, D.ACCT_OPN_DATE,
        A.ATM_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT, A.MBK_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT, A.RIB_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT FROM CBCTEST A 
    JOIN D360.STG_CRM_ACCOUNTS B ON A.ACCOUNTID = B.ACCOUNTID
    JOIN D360.STG_DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP C ON B.CORE_CUST_ID = C.CUST_ID
    JOIN D360.STG_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER D ON C.ACID = D.ACID
    LEFT JOIN CITY X ON A.ACCOUNTID = X.ACCOUNTID
    LEFT JOIN [STATE] Y ON A.ACCOUNTID = Y.ACCOUNTID
    ---JOIN D360.STG_CRM_ADDRESS E ON A.ACCOUNTID = E.ACCOUNTID
    WHERE B.ORGKEY LIKE 'R%' OR B.ORGKEY LIKE 'P%'
    ORDER BY A.[GROUP]
